acceptanceCriteria: In a two-repository fixture the packet resolves the commit in the source repo and carries files, hunks, obligations and notes within --max-bytes.
The packet records source identity and resolved revision.
An unknown source or commit refuses with a named code.
body: gate packet --commit REV --source <path|configured name> (or per-program sourceRepository config) resolves REV and diff base in that repository; same bounded contents within --max-bytes; packet records source repository identity and resolved revision.
title: GH #1217: gate packet --commit resolves in a configured source repository (--source / sourceRepository)
